proof_0193.moves: Commute the product a*b to b*a and then invoke the already-proved right-hand cancellation law for Euclidean division, using the nonzero hypothesis on a.

proof_0194.moves: Since colimit.pre is an isomorphism, move its inverse to the other side of the composite (the comp_inv_eq cancellation), reducing the goal to the known compatibility colimit.ι_pre; simp then closes it.

proof_0195.moves: Split the iff into its two directions: forward, transport a face relation back along an injective linear map; backward, push a face relation forward under the map. The proof is entirely the two-direction case split plus one lemma per direction.

proof_0196.moves: Apply the existing fact that a cast nonnegative rational commutes with any element, then take the symmetric form of that commutation.

proof_0197.moves: Destructure the divisibility hypothesis into an explicit multiple (write the divided quantity as a product) and substitute, reducing the goal to the gcd lemma for adding a multiple of the second argument.

proof_0198.moves: Induction on the number of iterations: iterating the n-th power map k times gives the n^k power map, the inductive step being the power-of-a-power law. The real content is the recursion on k, carried here by an auto-generated recursive helper.

proof_0199.moves: Unfold the 32-bit view as a cast of the platform-width bitvector, rewrite with the fact that USize's toBitVec commutes with mod, and push the resulting equality through the BitVec.cast congruence. Mostly rewriting plus a congruence step.

proof_0200.moves: A Bool-level restatement of left-cancellation for BitVec addition: turn the boolean equality test into propositional equality, apply add_right_inj, and convert back through propext. Essentially simp normalization around one real cancellation lemma.

proof_0201.moves: Direct appeal to the corresponding clamping lemma: truncation and clamping agree on the Fin value, so the statement is just that lemma applied.

proof_0202.moves: Unfold conjugation by an isomorphism as the composite alpha.symm ≪≫ f ≪≫ alpha, using extensionality for Aut to reduce equality of automorphisms to equality of their underlying isomorphisms; then it is definitional.

proof_0203.moves: Pure definitional unfolding (rfl): the functor from coalgebras of the product comonad to the over-category sends a coalgebra map to the same underlying morphism, and its structure map is the coalgebra map followed by the first projection. Nothing is proved beyond reading off the definition.

proof_0204.moves: Definitional unfolding (rfl): the unit morphism of the monoidal structure on the inverse of the double-monoidal-opposite equivalence is the identity after stripping two unmop's. No mathematical step beyond unfolding.

proof_0205.moves: Unfold the 64-bit view of an ISize as a cast of its platform-width bitvector, rewrite with the known description of Int64.toISize on bitvectors (sign extension), and transport through the BitVec.cast congruence. Rewriting plus a cast congruence.

proof_0206.moves: Split the iff: one direction is the duality lemma turning limits in the opposite category into colimits, the other direction is obtained by instance search (the dual construction is already an instance).

proof_0207.moves: Definitional unfolding (rfl): the hom component of the isomorphism of frames built from an order isomorphism is the underlying order map. No content beyond reading the constructor.

proof_0208.moves: Integer strict inequality a < x unfolds to a + 1 ≤ x, so the statement is exactly the non-strict le_min characterization applied at a + 1. The successor shift is the whole idea.

proof_0209.moves: Destructure both IsNat hypotheses (each says the ordinal is the cast of a natural), substitute, and then use that the natural-number cast into the ordinals is multiplicative; repackage with the IsNat constructor.

proof_0210.moves: The reassociated form of coprod.inl_fst: whisker the known identity on the right by an arbitrary morphism and reassociate. The only mathematical input is inl_fst; the rest is associativity/unit bookkeeping generated by the reassoc machinery.

proof_0211.moves: Definitional unfolding (rfl): whiskering a simplicial object by a functor commutes with the face maps because delta is by definition the simplicial object applied to op of the face inclusion. No step beyond unfolding.

proof_0212.moves: Definitional unfolding (rfl): the underlying natural transformation of the identity morphism in the category of lax monoidal functors is the identity of the underlying functor, which holds by construction of that category instance.

proof_0213.moves: Direct application of the general joint-surjectivity statement for colimit cocones in Type: every point of the colimit is hit by some component of the cocone.

proof_0214.moves: Definitional unfolding (rfl): the counit isomorphism of the equivalence of discrete categories induced by an equivalence of types is the isomorphism built from the type-level round trip. Reading off the definition, nothing proved.

proof_0215.moves: Definitional unfolding (rfl): the second component of the symmetrized homotopy is read directly off the definition of Homotopy.symm. Projection lemma with no argument.

proof_0216.moves: Definitional unfolding (rfl): the ring homomorphism lifted out of the direct limit, precomposed with the canonical map from a stage, is the original compatible family at that stage, true by construction of lift on the quotient representatives.
